list.title: Seoul food picks from Rhea and Nick
list.desc: Places from Rhea and Nick's Substack post 'SEOUL FOOD (GUIDE)' (https://rheaandnick.substack.com/p/seoul-food), companion to their video 'A Very Opinionated Seoul Guide (2026)' (https://youtu.be/OypWPyxtt5c). Collected by PinWith, not made by Rhea and Nick.

items.title: Jamsugyo-jip Haebangchon (잠수교집)
items.memo: Thin-sliced pork belly, then fried rice from the crispy bits and banchan.

items.title: Sotdukkeop Yangjae (솥뚜껑)
items.memo: Pork belly on cast iron with inventive dipping sauces.
items.check: post says 'sotdokkeop' in Seocho-dong; matched to Yangjae main branch

items.title: Jangsu Jeongyuk Sikdang (장수정육식당)
items.memo: Thick pork belly slices and strong banchan.

items.title: Jongsamyook (종삼육)
items.memo: KBBQ in the Donui-dong back-street dining strip by Jongno 3-ga.

items.title: Kkokkio Jangjakgui (꼬끼오장작구이)
items.memo: Rotisserie chicken over scorched rice; corn cheese, draft Terra.

items.title: Namdaemun Kalguksu Alley
items.memo: Many stalls doing kalguksu lunch sets; cash only.

items.title: Yetnal Guksi (옛날국시)
items.memo: Itaewon spot for ice-cold spicy acorn jelly rice soup (dotorimuk-bap).

items.title: Sosin Isso
items.memo: Spicy short ribs with glass noodles, tteok and mushrooms, off Yonsei-ro.

items.title: Manbok Guksujip (만복국수집)
items.memo: Tavern for bossam, kimchi pancakes and dongdongju.
